notes: Account summary: CodeHarbor = large enterprise dev platform (monorepo for dozens of products). Primary ask: replace brittle internal grep + Elastic layer with dense embeddings + reranking for code search.

Scale: expect ~250M embeddings initially (indexing all repos + historical commits). Index growth estimated 10-15% monthly. Want ability to do incremental updates every 15-30 minutes, full nightly reindex for housekeeping.
Latency & throughput targets: target 95th <= 200ms for combined vector retrieval + lightweight reranker (top-10 rerank). QPS baseline for POC = 200 qps; production target 1k+ qps across regions.
Cost sensitivity: engineering org goal is <$0.001 per query average (vector search + rerank). Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations (quantization, batching) to hit cost target.
Search architecture preferences: hybrid retrieval (dense embeddings + BM25 prefilter). Evaluating FAISS/Annoy/Milvus alternatives but want Redwood to manage serving and autoscaling.

Embedding models: currently using open-source code embedding (bge-code-small) and experimenting with OpenAI code embeddings. Want to evaluate Redwood's model catalog and ability to host pinned model versions.

Reranking: customer uses a small cross-encoder reranker (~60M params) to improve precision for top-10 results. They want a flow where vector store returns candidates then Redwood reranks on the same request with latency SLOs.

Security/compliance: must support SSO (SAML), enterprise KMS for key control, audit logs with 1y retention, and EU data residency for EU traffic. They prefer Private (VPC) or on-prem deployment for mainland EU prod clusters.

POC ask: 2-week pilot using Redwood Dedicated or Private node. Pilot scope: index ~50M embeddings, run 5 canonical search workloads, measure 95/99 latency, cost per query, and rerank uplift. Deliverables: perf report + tuning suggestions.
Quote from CTO: "We cannot compromise on P95 — developer productivity drops if searches stall. Also want predictable unit economics for billing teams."

Internal doc request: CH eng team requested an engineering-runbook template for reindex strategies (incremental vs full), KV cache invalidation, and recommended batching + quantization settings. Wants this before pilot start.

Notes on reindexing: heavy commit churn — they need near-real-time partial updates plus nightly compaction. Concern: full reindex windows cause CPU/GPU contention; asking about Redwood autoscaling and throttled reindex policies.

SE comments (Marco): try Dedicated with autoscale + prefix caching; propose 8xA100-equivalents for pilot traffic pattern. Also suggested Redwood Optimize probes to recommend quantization (int8) and KV cache lifetimes.
Next internal ask: obtain SAML metadata, confirm expected commit rate (events/min), provide sample index size (GB) and query traces for pre-pilot perf modeling.
